title: Flashduino — Arduino en el navegador
description: Programa tu Arduino desde VS Code en GitHub Codespaces con un solo botón, por USB y sin instalar nada en tu ordenador. Ideal para Chromebooks.

title: Spring is here
description: Celebrate successful terminal commands with a customizable emoji shower on macOS. Choose your emoji, particle count, size, speed, and more.

title: Muse Studio for VS Code
description: Community-built, not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta. A side panel for the Muse Code agent: Allow/Reject approvals, @-file mentions, images, editor context, review and undo of every change, model and permission pickers.

title: Quillo
description: Quillo language support: highlighting, diagnostics, quick fixes, hover, go to definition, completion, end tags closed as you type, outline (via `quillo lsp`) and debugging (via `quillo dap`).

title: Docker and Podman Studio
description: Visual Studio GUI for Docker & Podman: interactive Compose topology graph, Compose stacks, Containers, Pods, Images, Volumes, Networks, Contexts, and Podman Machine.

title: Auto Boilerplate
description: Automatically inserts clean starter boilerplate code and positions the cursor when creating or opening empty files.

title: PHL
description: PHL and HPL support: highlighting, errors as you type, outline, hover with value paths, and completion.

title: Codex Contingent
description: Codex subscription quota and reset times in the status bar, using the local Codex CLI.

title: Code Companions
description: A pixel pet in VS Code that reacts to what Claude Code is doing: thinking, editing, reading, running commands, waiting for you.

title: CanariaWerx SuiteScript Snippets
description: Code snippets for NetSuite SuiteScript 2.1, with legacy SuiteScript 1.0 templates for existing scripts

title: Clawd Pet
description: Una mascota virtual inspirada en Clawd, la mascota de Claude Code, que vive en tu VS Code.
